tasks.title: Prepare promotion while preserving existing intent
tasks.goal: Compute exact proposed authored changes from an accepted inventory/proposal scope.
steps: Consume M-02 binding and M-11-B proposal; resolve exact selected facts/options and full affected reference/write sets.
Diff against existing authored desired intent; preserve owner values/comments and report conflicting intent as typed input requirements.
Validate generated outcomes in memory and expose a concrete saved-state promotion plan with required snapshot/ownership/edit-barrier preconditions.
positive_cases: Nonconflicting observed proposals become exact additive authored edits.
Existing desired choices are retained and conflicts are reviewable.
negative_cases: Incomplete/truncated proposal or stale source cannot be promoted as complete.
Promotion preparation cannot save dirty buffers or overwrite authored intent.
acceptance: Plan identifies every affected input/output and exact authoring diff.
Prepare is pure and leaves all source/lock/state bytes unchanged.
tasks.safe_stop: Concrete promotion plan awaits its explicit apply operation.
notes: Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff commands are existing self-check gates.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Apply promotion with full affected-set revalidation
tasks.goal: Commit an explicitly selected promotion under cooperative exclusion and journaled recovery.
steps: Acquire the M-16 edit barrier and domain writer ownership for all affected resources; revalidate content and directory membership, including outside the direct write set.
Publish authored changes using retained before-images/CAS and existing migration transaction mechanisms; regenerate only declared derived outputs.
Inspect post-state independently, record completed/pending effects and expose recovery for interruption without accepting unknown third state.
positive_cases: An unchanged captured proposal applies exactly once and preserves unrelated intent.
Supported recovery restores or completes the exact owned prefix.
negative_cases: Dirty/disconnected participant, outside-write change or membership drift prevents further writes.
Partial failure cannot be labeled complete promotion or trigger automatic repair.
acceptance: Injected races/failures preserve exact applicability and partial-state evidence.
Observation becomes authored intent only through this explicit transaction.
tasks.safe_stop: Promotion transaction is proven locally; no production dispatched.
